header.experiment: audio interference compute — cavity + pump + square-law rectifier
header.mechanism: DATA spectrum settles in a damped 32-mode acoustic cavity; a sustained POWER pump on mode 2 mediates a nonlinear template-recall coupling and heterodynes the data into a square-law (autocorrelation) readout. alpha=0 removes both: passive linear filtering only.
header.falsifiers: linear control matches cavity recall; pump-off readout SNR does not collapse; cue classification at chance (20%).
header.claim_scope: compute PRIMITIVE (resonant associative recall + rectification), not a model
header.exploration_note: Design-space exploration during the build (raw vs floored-pseudoinverse whitened coupling, detune on/off, saturating pump-fed gain, beta 6-24, settle 0.5-1.4 s, four readout variants) found NO regime in which the cavity beats the linear control on recall by the gated margin: the passive nearest-neighbour readout is near-optimal on noise-only inputs (0.92-0.98) and 40%-zeroed inputs sit at an information ceiling (~0.45-0.60) for every readout, because the zeroed modes carry the discriminating payload of the confusable prompt bank. Shipped configuration is the spec's plain form (raw coupling, beta 9, settle 0.5 s); gates are reported as measured.

test2_power_gating.metric_note: SNR = matched-filter fidelity of the readout vector (correct-template projection vs orthogonal residual). margin_ratio (correct/wrong cosine ratio) is reported alongside; it reads ~0 dB in both arms because the rectified signatures are mutually >0.99 cosine.

cost_proxies_NOT_joules.note: dissipation = time-integral of sum gamma_n |a_n|^2 (arbitrary units). The overlap count is the cost of SIMULATING the cavity on a von Neumann machine, not the cost of the physical device, whose settling is parallel.
